Class
Description
AbstractFileRepository<ID,E>
Repository that persists the entities in a text file, one per line (Template Method pattern: the read/write skeleton is here, the subclasses only provide the line - entity conversion).
ComunitateSociabila
Result of the search for the most sociable community: its members, the length and the longest path.
ConfigException
Unchecked exception thrown when the application configuration is missing, unreadable or invalid.
ConsoleUI
Console interface: numbered menu, input reading and checking, results display.
Entity<ID>
Base class for the application entities, identified by an id.
EntityNotFoundException
Unchecked exception thrown when a requested entity (user, friendship) does not exist.
InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Repository that keeps the entities in memory, in a Map (insertion order is preserved).
LoadWarnings
Collects the warnings produced while loading persistent data (for example corrupt file lines).
Main
Entry point: loads the configuration, builds the objects (constructor Dependency Injection) and starts the interface.
Prietenie
A friendship between two users.
PrietenieDbRepository
Database repository skeleton for friendships.
PrietenieFileRepository
Friendships repository stored in a text file.
PrietenieService
Business logic for friendships: add and delete, with the related checks.
PrietenieServiceImpl
Default implementation of PrietenieService.
PrietenieValidator
Validator for Prietenie: non-null and different ids, referring to existing users.
Repository<ID,E>
CRUD contract for entities identified by an ID.
RepositoryException
Unchecked exception thrown on persistence errors.
RepositoryFactory
Simple Factory that creates the repositories according to the repository.type property (MEMORY, FILE or DATABASE).
RepositoryType
The persistence types supported by RepositoryFactory.
ReteaService
Analysis of the network: communities, the most sociable community and the loading report.
ReteaServiceImpl
Default implementation of ReteaService: builds the friendship graph (adjacency lists) and runs DFS (communities) and backtracking (longest path) on it.
ServiceException
Unchecked exception for business-logic errors (for example a duplicate friendship).
Tuple<E1,E2>
Ordered pair of two values, used as a composite identifier.
